protocol_reminder: 1) navigate_page to URL. 2) Run ALL-IN-ONE evaluate_script (waits UP TO 15s for REAL content — detects and waits through spinners, 'Loading...' text, and skeletons). 3) hasContent is only true when REAL content loaded (not just a spinner). isStillLoading=true after 15s = STUCK page = major finding. 4) Breadcrumb REQUIRED: .backdrop-blur-sm nav must have text content — missing = minor finding. 5) If PASS: record js_check in page_results. 6) If FAIL: take_snapshot + take_screenshot to FILE, create finding. 7) NEVER call wait_for(). 8) After 20 pages, SAVE and yield.

rules: NEVER mark page passed without navigate_page + evaluate_script JS check in THIS iteration
HTTP HEAD does NOT count as verification - must actually navigate and run JS check
Console errors auto-create findings - cannot be ignored or skipped
Each iteration must test at least 5 pages via full SPTP
Evidence must be fresh from THIS iteration - never copy from prior iterations
On FAILURE: must save snapshot + screenshot to FILE before moving on
After 20 pages in one iteration, SAVE STATE and yield
Re-read protocol_reminder at iteration start to avoid protocol drift

findings.description: Price Histories table has 30 rows but scroll container cannot scroll (scrollHeight=574, clientHeight=574). Users cannot access all rows.
findings.fix_hint: Missing min-h-0 on flex parent of TeeemTableView. CSS default min-height:auto on flex items prevents the scroll container from being bounded.
findings.root_cause: QA check measured [role=region] scrollHeight but TeeemTableView actual scroll container is nested div.overflow-auto with scrollHeight=164,668px - table scrolls perfectly fine
findings.fix_approach: Updated QA scroll check in QA_RALPH_PROMPT.md to look for inner .overflow-auto container instead of region wrapper

findings.description: Financial Transactions table has 51 rows but scroll container cannot scroll (scrollHeight=1429, clientHeight=1429). Users cannot access all rows.
findings.fix_hint: Missing min-h-0 on flex parent of TeeemTableView. CSS default min-height:auto on flex items prevents the scroll container from being bounded.
findings.root_cause: Two-layer bug: (1) TabsContent lacked min-h-0 [FIXED in base component]. (2) TabsContent has display:block so children overflow despite bounded height. XeroStatementView Card chain needs flex-col+overflow-hidden on TabsContent AND height constraints on the Card/content chain inside XeroStatementView.
findings.fix_approach: Partial fix deployed (min-h-0 on base TabsContent). Still needs: add flex flex-col overflow-hidden to Xero TabsContent className, and fix XeroStatementView to pass height constraints to its TeeemTableView.
